subject: Geo-hosting runbook + keystore walkthrough for compliance packet
messages:
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@helixhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: runbook + keystore walkthrough for EU-only hosting

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well. As part of HelixHealth's compliance intake for our pilot, we need a compact evidence packet showing:
- Confirmation that Redwood can host workloads and persist data entirely within the EU (specifically: AWS eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 options).
- A short runbook (network diagram + peering options) for Private deployment (VPC peering / Privatelink) and fallback routing.
- A walkthrough of keystore/KMS handling for tenant separation and key rotation (we prefer HSM-backed KMS).
- Pointer to the CAIQ/SIG mapping and SOC 2 report excerpts that reference data residency and logging retention.

Could you share a runbook and schedule a short (30–45m) keystore walkthrough/demo next week? We're under a compressed procurement timeline — ideally before the 12th.

Thanks,
Alex Miller
Compliance Manager, HelixHealth
security@helixhealth.com

Attachments: helix_evidence_request.pdf (form from procurement)
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@helixhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: runbook + keystore walkthrough for EU-only hosting

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the form. We're happy to support HelixHealth on this.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes — we offer EU-only hosting via dedicated VPC/private deployment in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 and can lock storage + compute to those AZs.
- We support HSM-backed customer KMS (via partner HSM or customer-managed CloudHSM) and tenant-scoped key partitions.
- We'll prepare a concise runbook + network diagram and a CAIQ/SIG mapping excerpt trimmed for your review.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached an initial runbook extract and the KMS keyflow diagram for review.
2) Can we do a 30-minute keystore walkthrough on Thursday 2027-05-06 at 14:00 CEST? If that doesn't work, Friday morning also works.
3) Irene (cc'd) will provide the CAIQ/SIG mapping slice and SOC 2 pointers. Marissa will coordinate the MAP/PO path.

Attachments: redwood_eu_hosting_runbook.pdf, kms-keyflow-diagram.png

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+44 20 7946 0123
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Miller <alex.miller@helixhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: runbook + keystore walkthrough for EU-only hosting

Alex / team — adding a few technical clarifications so the packet answers the usual audit questions: 
- VPC/Networking: our private deployment supports single-tenant VPCs peered via AWS PrivateLink or VPC Peering. The runbook shows primary paths + documented failover to a second EU region; we can disable cross-region replication if you require strict EU-only at rest.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed CloudHSM and partner HSM integrations. Tenant key separation is enforced by separate CMKs per-tenant + access policies; rotation can be automated or scheduled.
- Logs & Retention: Audit and request logs are retained according to the contracted retention window — default is 90 days for debug traces and 365 days for audit trails; we can extend retention as part of an enterprise add-on.
- CAIQ/SIG: I'll attach a redacted CAIQ-SIG mapping workbook that maps each Helix control to our evidence artifacts. SOC 2 excerpts will be provided via a gated link (we redact customer-specific usage).

Attachments: caiq-sig-mapping.xlsx

--
Irene Choi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@helixhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: runbook + keystore walkthrough for EU-only hosting

Thanks, team — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before the walkthrough:
- Is the HSM option available for Redwood-hosted Dedicated nodes or only for Private (customer-managed) deployments? We want HSM for production keys.
- Can you confirm that egress to non-EU destinations is blocked by default for EU-only tenants, or is that a configuration we need to request?
- For tenant key partitioning: does Redwood maintain any shared key escrow, or can keys be exclusively controlled by Helix?
- Can we get a short demo of the rotation process and the IAM policy changes required to grant Helix operator users access?

Also — procurement asked for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template we can populate together. Can Marissa share a starter MAP and proposed timeline?

Alex Miller
Compliance Manager, HelixHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@helixhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Alex — looping in a starter MAP and timeline. High level:

- Week 4: Pilot go-live (limited traffic).

I've attached a draft MAP you can edit with dates and PO milestones. If you confirm a walkthrough on 2027-05-06 14:00 CEST we can lock resources and invite our infra engineer for the demo.
